candidate.user_input: For meals while traveling to a workshop, determine which budget funds them and the daily meal cap including tips; do not charge meals to G&D.
candidate.reference: Travel, lodging, and meals related to conferences or workshops must be expensed separately from the G&D claim and should follow GitLab's Travel and Expense policy. These expenses are funded from the requestor's department Travel & Expense budget, not from the G&D allocation. Meals while traveling on Company business are reimbursable, up to $120 USD (or local equivalent currency) per day. Tips are acceptable up to 20% and should be detailed accordingly in the description box. This should be included in the final price to stay within the Policy limits.
